# Release tool qualification fixtures

Tracked snapshots of the original operator-owned modding and conserved-liquid
projects, plus the material lab HDR. Kept here so all SDK tool reproduction
commands work from an engine-only source archive without deleted /tmp scripts
or dependence on later game edits. They are test content, not SDK runtime data.
Original projects/evidence remain untouched. Test runners copy these fixtures
before baking or authoring. The font retains its included upstream licence.
